caption:
Every morning on the expedition starts with black beans, rice, plantains and local coffee.

Each breakfast is included across the 9 days, whether we wake at 2,200 metres in San Gerardo de Dota or down along the coast. When you have 25 kilometres and 2,350 metres of descent ahead on the Queen Stage, you eat what the valley grows. Later that morning, mountain families along the Río Savegre open their kitchen doors with fruit, empanadas and agua dulce.

6 to 8 athletes, 2 guides, 1 dedicated photographer, and a shared table every evening.

The Trail Running Expedition: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
